existing_binding_source_observation.decision: No pynvml is visible to the prescribed no-user-site project runtime. Use the small source ctypes binding, rather than enabling or modifying the unrelated user site.

official_manual_refs.excerpt: It is thread-safe and provides the underlying functionality for the NVIDIA System Management Interface (nvidia-smi).

public_semantics.meaning: Compute API returns active compute contexts, not graphics; usedGpuMemory is bytes; size query may return SUCCESS only for empty list or INSUFFICIENT_SIZE with required count; list can change; permission/not-supported/unknown errors are errors; MIG aggregate access may require privileges.

Process-name API may crop to caller buffer, ANSI encoding, and may fail for disappeared or inaccessible processes. Candidate uses large bounded buffer, rejects saturation/decoding/unknown errors, and never drops the process.
MIG query returns current/pending modes or explicit NOT_SUPPORTED when device lacks MIG support. Enabled, pending and all other errors reject the inventory.
NVML_SUCCESS=0; NOT_SUPPORTED=3; NO_PERMISSION=4; INSUFFICIENT_SIZE=7. Device/process memory NOT_AVAILABLE sentinel is not admitted.
